title: موٹر سائیکل کا روزہ (Motorcycle Roza)
location: Streetside curb next to a parked vintage red Honda CD70 motorbike
prop: Red Honda CD70 motorbike with empty chrome petrol tank
staging: Physical Staging: @Shani is actively seated mounted on the black saddle of the Honda CD70 motorcycle, his hands gripping the chrome handlebars and his feet resting on the ground, tapping the fuel tank with a deadpan innocent expression. @Mani stands right beside the front wheel of the motorbike, leaning casually against the roadside curb with a sarcastic, mocking smirk, looking down toward @Shani. Both bodies are angled in an open 3/4 stance toward the camera lens. Casual friendly buddy banter, lighthearted comedic banter, strictly NO aggression, NO confrontational fighting posture.

scene_1.dialogue_at_00: اوئے شانی، کیا ہوا؟ پٹرول ختم ہو گیا ہے کیا؟
scene_1.dialogue_at_03: نہیں بھائی مانی، میری موٹر سائیکل کا آج نفلی روزہ ہے!

title: لوڈشیڈنگ اور موم بتی (Loadshedding Candle)
location: Dim living room at night with darkness outside the window
prop: A single lit wax candle on a low table, and a glowing smartphone screen
staging: Physical Staging: @Shani is slumped comfortably on the left side of a living room sofa, holding his glowing smartphone close to his face in exaggerated grief over 1% battery. @Mani sits relaxed on the other side of the sofa, leaning forward and pointing with an amused, teasing grin at an unlit wax candle sitting on the coffee table. Both faces visible in warm 3/4 cinematic angle. Relaxed desi bachelors buddy comedy, friendly laughing atmosphere.

scene_1.dialogue_at_00: شانی لائٹ چلی گئی ہے، وہ دیکھ موم بتی پڑی ہے!
scene_1.dialogue_at_03: بھائی مانی، کیا موم بتی کی آگ سے میرا موبائل چارج ہو جائے گا؟

title: پاکستانی جگاڑ پنکھا (Ceiling Fan Jugaad)
location: Pakistani bedroom directly underneath a stationary ceiling fan
prop: Long wooden broom stick touching the edge of a ceiling fan blade
staging: Physical Staging: @Shani stands under the ceiling fan holding a long wooden stick stretched upward, carefully trying to give the fan blade a manual push-start with serious comical concentration. @Mani sits casually on the corner of a nearby wooden bed/charpai, leaning on his knee with hands open, chuckling and shaking his head in complete amused disbelief at Shani's absurd jugaad. Relaxed funny buddy interaction, no fighting.

scene_1.dialogue_at_00: اوئے شانی، پنکھے کو ڈنڈے سے گھما کر کیا ثابت کرنا چاہتے ہو؟
scene_1.dialogue_at_03: بھائی اس کو پہلی کِک مار رہا ہوں، ایک بار سٹارٹ ہو جائے تو چلے گا!

title: 45 ڈگری اور کڑک چائے (Hot Tea in Summer)
location: Roadside Pakistani Chai Dhaba with wooden benches and rustic tea counter
prop: Two clear traditional glass cups filled with hot steaming doodh patti chai
staging: Physical Staging: Both friends are comfortably seated side-by-side on a rustic wooden dhaba bench at a 3/4 angle to the camera. @Shani holds a hot steaming glass of doodh patti tea near his chest, looking completely blissful and satisfied despite the hot weather. @Mani has a small white cotton towel over his shoulder, holding his tea glass with two fingers and looking at Shani with funny bewildered sarcasm. Warm friendly banter, desi dhaba comedy.

scene_1.dialogue_at_00: باہر پنتالیس ڈگری گرمی ہے اور تم ابلتی ہوئی کڑک چائے پی رہے ہو؟
scene_1.dialogue_at_03: بھائی گرمی کو گرمی ہی کاٹتی ہے، تجھے سائنس کا کیا پتہ!

title: رکشے والے کی جلدی (Rickshaw Driver Hurry)
location: Inside the passenger seat of a colorful green Pakistani auto rickshaw
prop: Green auto rickshaw frame and metal side handlebars
staging: Physical Staging: Both @Shani and @Mani are seated together in the rear passenger seat of a traditional Pakistani auto rickshaw, visible from an angled side-front camera shot. @Shani is tightly clutching the side metal support rod with wide comedic bulging eyes as if the rickshaw is flying. @Mani sits beside him, laughing sarcastically while gesturing with his hands. Hilarious buddy adventure, highly expressive comic fear and laughter.

scene_1.dialogue_at_00: شانی رکشے والے کو جلدی چلنے کا بولا تھا، وہ تو دو سو کی سپیڈ پر اڑا رہا ہے!
scene_1.dialogue_at_03: بھائی اس کو بولا تھا جلدی پہنچاؤ، اس نے سیدھا اوپر پہنچانے کی ٹھان لی ہے!

title: مہمان اور ٹھنڈا شربت (Pakistani Guest Sharbat)
location: Living room drawing room with a comfortable sofa and tea table
prop: An empty glass water jug and two tall glasses with red Rooh Afza residue on a glass table
staging: Physical Staging: @Shani and @Mani are relaxing on the drawing room sofa, angled in an open 3/4 stance toward the camera lens. On the coffee table in front of them rests a completely drained glass pitcher and empty glasses. @Mani points an accusatory funny finger at the empty jug with an amused, disbelieving smirk. @Shani leans back on the sofa armrest with a knowing, mischievous chuckle. Classic warm Pakistani household humor.

scene_1.dialogue_at_00: مہمان کہہ رہے تھے ہم کچھ نہیں لیں گے، اور پورا جگ شربت پی گئے!
scene_1.dialogue_at_03: بھائی تکلف صرف پہلے گلاس تک ہوتا ہے، اس کے بعد وہ اپنے گھر والے بن جاتے ہیں!
